column1: # results_manifest.tsv — the ONE source for every number in the thesis.
# One row = one fold that contributes to a reported table. `python sweeps/report.py`
# reads ONLY this file: no globbing, no deduplication, so a number cannot change
# because a new directory landed on disk. Adding a fold = adding a row here.
# report.py verifies each row against the run's hparams.yaml and fails loudly on a
# mismatch, so a wrong pin cannot go unnoticed.
# vintage: 2026-07 = current code, 80m-capped training (the reference protocol)
#          2026-05 = pre-'fresh restart' code; same CLAP backbone and same core
#                    hyper-parameters, but a different revision -> report as such
#          converged = trained to convergence instead of the 80m cap
# Deliberately NOT pinned: song 36 (drum) — outside the 5x4 design, May vintage,
#   conv_ct_raw_lso_song44 — the capped twin is pinned instead, to keep the row
#   protocol-consistent; conv_ct_raw_lso_song16 IS pinned because no capped twin exists.
# NOT REPRODUCIBLE BIT-FOR-BIT: the two `control` rows. checkpoint_test forces
#   shuffle=True for shuffle_test_mode != none (otherwise each batch carries a single task
#   and the in-batch permutation degenerates), and --workers auto-sizes to the machine, so
#   the permutation differs run to run. Re-running on 2026-07-26 gave labels 0.2500 and
#   audio_pair 0.3525 against the pinned 0.2250 / 0.3825 — and the pre-refactor code gave
#   the same 0.2500, so this is the control's own variance, not a code change. Cite them as
#   "at chance" and "far below the 0.865 headline", never as exact figures. The `within`
#   row (shuffle_test_mode=none) IS deterministic and reproduces 0.8650 exactly.
#   raw_loso_sub7 (0.408) — conflicts with repro_loso_sub7 (0.875) for the same fold;
#   repro_loso_sub7 is the pinned one. CORRECTED 2026-08-27: this line used to claim
#   repro_loso_sub{N} is what the committed scripts/replicate.sh produces, and that is
#   FALSE — phase `loso` writes akama_loso_sub{3,7,2}, so re-running replicate.sh
#   builds a PARALLEL series and does NOT refresh these three pins. The two ways to
#   neither is taken, because either would move a number.
#   results/baseline_sanity_* — the May run of the same three controls. The 18/07 re-run
#   (sanity_*) is pinned instead: identical numbers (0.8650 / 0.2250 / 0.3825) from the
#   same model-all0.ckpt, but current code AND the exact tags scripts/replicate.sh writes,
#   so re-running replicate refreshes these pins in place.
# MAD-EEG arm (Chapter 2) -- rows whose `model` is madeeg_ridge / madeeg_shrinkage / madeeg_cca
#   are read by report.py from <run_tag>/madeeg_records.csv and verified against that run's
#   madeeg_summary.txt. Two fields are re-read for this arm:
#       held_out -> --spatial   (stereo | mono)   [stereo and mono NEVER share a row: pooling
#                                                  them is a research decision not taken]
#   A control cannot be pinned by accident: --self_test writes madeeg_selftest_records.csv in
#   <tag>_selftest, so a pin aimed at it finds no madeeg_records.csv and fails loudly.
#   For the CONTRASTIVE models the same two fields are the ensemble and the fold count,
#   because that arm has no --train_on and no --spatial; the step is verified against the
#   marker its own summary title prints.
# NOT PINNED, and each for a stated reason -- never invent a pin:
#   step D (model 8, 0.4545 + G2 0.9221): its artefacts are NOT on this Mac. They exist only
#     inside the 28/7 report until the rsync from the cluster is run. Pin it the day they land.
#   the archived madeeg_ridge_{duo,duo_env,solos}: their summaries predate the --estimator and
#     --spatial flags, so the pin cannot be VERIFIED against them. The 30/7 re-runs below carry
#     the full header and reproduce those numbers byte-for-byte (same madeeg_records.csv md5).
#   0.5065 (duos+envelope): same reason, and no re-run with the current header exists yet.
# MODEL 9: no row yet -- the pre-registered look has not been run, and a pin to a run that does
#   not exist makes report.py refuse to write RESULTS.md at all.
